value.title: Path-form router policies

acceptanceCriteria.text: With repeated-slash merging on, `/a//b` matches `/a/b`; with it off, it does not. [D-053]

With trailing-slash ignoring on, `/users/` matches `/users` and `/users` matches a pattern registered as `/users/`; `/users//` does not match `/users` unless repeated-slash merging is also on; the root path `/` is never stripped to an empty path. [D-053]

With case-insensitive matching on, `/USERS/Bob` matches `/users/:name` and yields `name` = `Bob`, and the comparison is locale-independent (the same result under a Turkish default locale for `/LIST` against `/list`). [D-053; wave decision: path-form policy] Matching and prefix-middleware selection use the same locale-independent Unicode code-point folding policy on Java8 and Java17, including supplementary characters.

Each switch can be set without the others, the switches are fixed when the router is built, and a router built without setting any of them behaves as the strict default. [wave decision: path-form policy] [SDS 2026-10-19.naruserve.naruserve-v1-wave-2-2 SDS-AC-10] The router copies the immutable `RouterPolicy` at construction and offers no setter afterwards.

value.requirement: The system shall provide three independent router policy switches, each off by default, that merge repeated slashes, ignore one trailing slash, and compare literal segments case-insensitively, with path parameter values returned as received under every switch and the configuration API names on `RestApp` left to wave 3.
value.rationale: Covers D-053 and the wave decision on the path-form policy (D-050, D-053, D-070); the RestApp-level names are decided in wave 3 (D-398).
